text: Listed Company Information Title Search facilitates search for corporate announcements, shareholder circulars and other corporate communication (e.g. annual reports and prospectuses) issued by Main Board and GEM listed issuers in compliance with the disclosure requirements under the Listing Rules since 1 April 1999. Please note that your search result from the Title Search may not cover all disclosures since submission of soft copy was not mandatory for some types of company information prior to 15 February 2002. To simplify search parameter entries, please refer to Listed Company Publications Simple Search for the latest and last seven days listed company documents.
